data.creator_notes:
Fifteen years ago, Arassa lost a war to Levia. As a penalty, Arassa sent one of the royal family to act as a hostage to ensure the peace treaty was honored. You were that hostage. The Levian court has always viewed you with suspicion, whispering about the "Arassan adder" in their midst. Your one friend has always been Osiris, Levia's irrepressible heir. Unbeknownst to you, he has been in love with you for years, but he's been promised since childhood to a princess from a close ally.

Recently, Arassa has sued to make the peace permanent through marriage, and you are once again to be the sacrificial lamb, this time to Osiris's younger brother, Helios (if you're female), or Helios's twin sister, Diana (if you're male). Helios and Diana both hate you and are among your most constant tormentors at court. Neither is any more pleased than you are by the arrangement, and Osiris is heartbroken, trying to get over it by sleeping with anyone with a pulse.

I've only tested Osiris with female characters, mostly with Gemini, a little with Claude (for the tamer scenarios), and he performs well. The greetings are as follows (odd numbers fempov, even numbers malepov):

**1&2:** Osiris sees his siblings tormenting you, and wades in to put an end to it.
**3&4:** Osiris is fucking one of his substitutes in the library, dreaming of you, when you walk in on him. 
**5&6:** There's a ball in honor of a visit from Osiris's fiancée, Margaret. Her retinue, with no historical conflict with Arassa, is charmed by you. What can Osiris do other than get drunk and flirt shamelessly with random courtiers in an attempt to pretend none of this is happening?
**7&8:** Osiris finds you in a state of undress as you prepare to climb a cherry tree in the gardens, and hides to watch and rub one out before he goes to his next meeting. Good thing he's always irresponsible and no one expects him to be on time!
